verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rainforest runs one up-front merchant application that gets an approved, declined or manual-review outcome. Nothing documents letting sellers start selling on minimal information and collecting the rest before payout thresholds. The 'Needs Information' application status and the option to run verifications before submission are adjacent features, not tunable progressive onboarding with per-seller requirements-due states.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller
